question: How does doubt stand apart by auspicious and inauspicious fruit?
premises: By auspicious and inauspiciousness this will be born.
Fruit-abundance comes before or after enjoyment.
inference: Doubt stands apart according to auspicious or inauspicious fruit before or after enjoyment.
plain_english: By auspicious and inauspiciousness, this will be born with fruit-abundance, before or after enjoyment; this doubt stands apart.
